confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge and the supplied city context, not from live booking pages or current listings. Restaurant and beer anchors are more reliable than accommodation, and cocktail and wine are less certain. Kampot is a small riverside town with limited published price data, and July is rainy season with lower tourist volume, so accommodation rates may run below peak levels. Cocktail and wine were set relative to the beer anchor (roughly 3x and 3.3x). FX caveat: a search summary reported the RBA USD per AUD rate of 0.6955 for 2026-10-15, but I could not confirm that figure on rba.gov.au. Market quotes from OFX, Trading Economics and XE for mid-October 2026 are consistent with it, so treat the FX figure as unverified.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on other Cambodian provincial tourist towns such as Kep and Battambang, with riverside accommodation priced somewhat above Battambang and well below Siem Reap. Restaurant and drink prices follow Cambodian provincial tourist norms in USD.
